reviews_5s: I really love how pretty these are! I had basic mesh ones but over the years they've gotten a couple broken spots where I've cut myself. These metal ones are so much easier to clean. And yes, they are metal and metal rusts so I wouldn't recommend using the dish washer. I hand wash and immediately dry them off paying special attention to the base crease and handle area. It only takes a minute and I think the quality, sturdiness and beauty of them easily make up for having to hand wash them.Bought the pastel green as a wedding gift. They are absolutely darling. They’re so cute. I wanted to break the set up and keep one for myself. When the bride pulled them out of the gift bag, everybody loved them. They’re so cute I’m going to buy myself a set after writing this review.Bought these for the wife. Great product and looks true to the photo. Love the product.Love the look of these and that these stack. The size range is good and they work pretty well. I always put them in the dishwasher and they’re fine.Great was the perfect house warming giftSo pretty and well made!These metal colanders are a kitchen essential! They are super sturdy, rust-resistant, and have the perfect amount of drainage holes for rinsing fruits, veggies, and pasta. The handles make them easy to grip, and they feel much more durable than plastic alternatives. I also love the sleek, polished look—it adds a nice touch to my kitchen. Easy to clean and built to last, these colanders are definitely a great investment!These are beautiful and functional. reviews_1s:
Very disappointed in these strainers. After only 2 months of use (and hand wash only) they rusted.
Contacted customer service - no response. They may look pretty when you take them out of the box, but they won't last. A waste of money.I don’t recommend these. I only had them for two months and they started rusting quite badly. They looked beautiful brand new.I’m so sad the handles have started to rust and I’m past the return date. We’ve only ever hand washed these so be careful!!Beautiful pieces but mine rusted in two weeks. Will need to return.
